basic_info.description: Stunning top floor end unit condo in an elevator building desirably located between the heart of the Upper Haight, Lower Haight, and Divisadero Corridor. This beautifully updated 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo features a great layout, nice natural light, and views across the city. Views of the skyline and a peek-a-boo view of the top of the Golden Gate Bridge. An attractive kitchen with good counter and cabinet space and a breakfast bar. Both of the nice-sized bedrooms open to the deck. There are 2 gorgeous bathrooms. The primary suite bathroom offers 2 vanities. The inviting living room has a fireplace and views of trees and greenery. Recently installed handsome floors. A convenient in-unit laundry room completes this unit. 1 car side-by-side parking in the garage and an extra large private storage room that can fit a lot of gear and bikes. The building has a tranquil shared courtyard with landscaping and trees. This condo has a great location in between some of the best neighborhoods in SF. It's located across the street from Buena Vista Park and a couple blocks to the Panhandle of Golden Gate Park. Near Duboce Park and Alamo Square as well. Enjoy being close to many popular restaurants, cafes, bars, and shops. This move-in ready condo can be your new home or pied-a-terre.
